props.name: overflowEdgeThreshold
props.type: number | Partial<{ xStart: number; xEnd: number; yStart: number; yEnd: number; }>
props.description: The threshold in pixels that must be passed before the overflow edge attributes are applied. Accepts a single number for all edges or an object to configure them individually.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Whether to keep the HTML element in the DOM when the viewport isn't scrollable.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Whether the scrollbar controls vertical or horizontal scroll.
